senses.gloss: m. (אול to circle, v. חוּל, עול, cmp. עוֹלָם, תְּחִלָּה) beginning, early season.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 9:10">Targ. Hos. IX, 10</cite>; a. e.—<he>מן א׳</he> from the beginning (of the world).
Targ. Job. XX, 4; a. fr.—לאויל to (its) previous condition.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 16:55">Targ. Ez. XVI, 55</cite> (some ed. <he>לְאַוְלְהַן</he>). Cmp. <he>אלל</he>.
